replies.text: memory next to credential vaults is the right pairing. it is a write path into the agent's future context, so it needs its own permission boundary.
the agent-created canvas is the standout. congrats on 1.6.
recovery as a first-class feature is the right call. a phone agent that loses the tool loop on a call is just a chat UI with shell access.
merge to main. let it branch, test, and open the PR. the shared branch is where its mistakes become everyone's problem.
